attempts.rationale: trend dominated with moderate ranking stability suggests a weighted combo; try softmax_neg_error over full pool.
Test weighted combination with inverse_error weights to see if simple error‑based weighting improves over softmax_neg_error, given moderate ranking stability and trend dominance.
The series has high trend strength and moderate ranking stability; a robust non‑parametric combine like median may reduce influence of a few high‑error outliers.
test a trimmed_mean strategy to see if trimming high‑error outliers improves over median/weighted; this is a different kind of combination.
test a simple mean over the full pool to see if a non‑weighted average beats the median.
test a per‑horizon weighted combo using the top‑k mean handle (k=5) to see if horizon‑specific averaging beats the overall weighted mean.
The series is trend‑dominated with moderate ranking stability; a more flexible weighted approach like DBA might capture local performance variations better than global weights.
The series has moderate ranking stability and high trend; per‑horizon best‑model weighting might capture subtle horizon shifts.
test a simple inverse_error weighted combo (w1) to see if direct error inverse improves over softmax or other weights, given moderate ranking stability and trend dominance.
The series has moderate ranking stability and strong trend; try a weighted combo that adapts to error trends across windows, i.e., weights_error_trend on the full pool.
Test a weighted inverse-error combo on the top‑5 low‑error pool to see if a simpler weighting beats the median baseline.
test a per‑horizon weighted combo on the top‑5 low‑error pool, using the top‑k mean per‑horizon weights (w8) to capture horizon shifts.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w8' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8643. Series context: trend strength 0.9815 and seasonal strength 0.2283; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.446); 9 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 10.709.
